statement: A conference has 47 people attending. One woman knows 16 of the men attending, another knows 17, and so on up to the \(m\)-th woman who knows all \(n\) of the men. Find \(m\) and \(n\).
For what values of \(m\) does the equation \(x^2 + (2m+6)x + 4m+12 = 0\) have two real roots, both greater than \(-1\)?
Tetrahedron \(S.ABC\) has faces \(SBC\) and \(ABC\) perpendicular. The three angles at \(S\) are all \(60^\circ\) and \(SB = SC = 1\). Find the volume of the tetrahedron.

Triangle \(ABC\) has semiperimeter \(p\). Find \(BC\) and area \(S\) in terms of \(\angle A\), \(\angle B\), and \(p\). In particular, compute \(S\) when \(p \approx 23.6\), \(\angle A \approx 52^\circ 42'\), \(\angle B \approx 46^\circ 16'\).
